$description: Role names shared by every brand. Names match shadcn/ui CSS variables. Each role aliases the active brand value; a brand file missing a role fails the build.

accent.$description: Hover and highlight wash: 5% of primary mixed into the popover surface

accent-foreground.$description: Text on accent: the normal popover text colour

ring.$description: Focus outline; opaque, at least 3:1 on background, card, popover, muted and accent

success-soft.$description: Soft wash behind success callouts, alerts and tinted buttons and badges: the success role mixed into the card (13% light, 19% dark)

success-soft-foreground.$description: Text on success-soft: the success role, mixed toward card-foreground only as far as 4.5:1 on the wash needs

success-line.$description: Border or rule of a success callout: the success role mixed into the card (from 45% light, 47% dark), raised until it reaches 3:1 on background and card

warning-soft.$description: Soft wash behind warning callouts, alerts and tinted buttons and badges: the warning role mixed into the card (13% light, 19% dark)

warning-soft-foreground.$description: Text on warning-soft: the warning role, mixed toward card-foreground only as far as 4.5:1 on the wash needs

warning-line.$description: Border or rule of a warning callout: the warning role mixed into the card (from 45% light, 47% dark), raised until it reaches 3:1 on background and card

info-soft.$description: Soft wash behind informational callouts, alerts and tinted buttons and badges: the info role mixed into the card (13% light, 19% dark)

info-soft-foreground.$description: Text on info-soft: the info role, mixed toward card-foreground only as far as 4.5:1 on the wash needs

info-line.$description: Border or rule of a informational callout: the info role mixed into the card (from 45% light, 47% dark), raised until it reaches 3:1 on background and card

destructive-soft.$description: Soft wash behind destructive callouts, alerts and tinted buttons and badges: the destructive role mixed into the card (13% light, 19% dark)

destructive-soft-foreground.$description: Text on destructive-soft: the destructive role, mixed toward card-foreground only as far as 4.5:1 on the wash needs

destructive-line.$description: Border or rule of a destructive callout: the destructive role mixed into the card (from 45% light, 47% dark), raised until it reaches 3:1 on background and card

radius.$description: Base radius; radius-sm..4xl derive from it.
